MBA 693R · STRAT 490R

The **BYU AI Foundry** is an AI-native product studio and consultancy, and an official program
of the BYU Marriott School of Business. We build AI products. One team works out what is worth
building and then ships it, because those are no longer two jobs.

This site is the course and partner handbook for the Foundry's delivery work. Students carry
academic credit through the AI Foundry Lab while working on real client engagements.

The Foundry is not an internship placement and not a research project. Every engagement ends
with software running in the client's hands.

Students typically complete
[MSB 341 - Product Management](https://byu-strategy.github.io/product-management/)
before joining a delivery team, so they arrive with product and applied AI skills already built.

## Course Numbers

This course is cross-listed under two course numbers. It is all the same class: everyone meets
together Fridays 8:00 to 11:50 AM in 2140 TNRB, works on the same client teams, uses this site,
and is graded on the same rubric. Register under whichever number fits your program.

| Course | Section | Title | Credit Hours |
|--------|---------|-------|--------------|
| MBA 693R | 011 | Special Topics in Management | 3.0 |
| STRAT 490R | 001 | Topics in Strategic Management | 3.0 |

Mixed MBA and undergraduate teams are intentional. The MBAs bring the business judgment, the
undergraduate builders bring engineering depth, and on a Foundry team those are the same job.

## What We Do

Three offerings. Engagements usually combine them.

| Offering | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Full-stack applications** | Net-new web and mobile applications, built end to end and shipped to production. B2C, B2B, and internal tools |
| **AI integration and orchestration** | AI wired into systems the client already runs. Agents and copilots over their data, automations across Slack and Notion, document processing and routing |
| **AI enablement and training** | Setting the client's team up to build this way themselves, on the same tooling we use. Co-working, then handoff |

## How Engagements Run

**Find the problem, build the thing, hand it over.** One fixed fee of **$22,000** covers all
three phases across an 8-month engagement.

| | Phase | What we deliver |
|---|---|---|
| **01** | Audit and discovery | An AI-specific audit that points at specific things to build, with an estimate and a sequence |
| **02** | Build | Production code, integrated with the client's systems, running in their environment |
| **03** | Transfer | Co-working throughout the build, then handoff. The capability stays in-house |

## Intake

Engagements are accepted on a **rolling basis**. There is no application deadline and no single
annual intake. Teams are staffed as engagements are confirmed, limited by bench capacity.

Course dates that do apply to students, including required studio sessions and the final
reflection, are in the [Syllabus](students/01-syllabus.qmd).
